# REG_MMM_BAYES coverage study

Generated by `TestMMMBayes_CoverageStudy` (`contrib/mmmpulse/bayes_coverage_study_test.go`, build tag `mmmcoverage`; report in `bayes_coverage_test.go`); never hand-edit. Reproduce with:

```sh
cd contrib/mmmpulse && go test -count=1 -tags mmmcoverage -run TestMMMBayes_CoverageStudy -timeout 3h -v . -mmm.coverage-workers 2
```

## Design

- 50 replicates of the joint-truth scenario: replicate i fits `mmmfixture.JointWithSeed(1001 + i)` (fresh spend, price, promo and noise over the same channels, curves and controls; 156 weeks, 4 channels) with `rng_seed` i + 1.
- Each fit is the default `REG_MMM_BAYES` slot (default priors; 4 chains × (1000 warmup + 1000 draws); every week; no holdout).
- Per channel: is the true ROI (summed true contribution over summed spend) inside `outputs.roi.<channel>` [lower, upper], and the true contribution (summed over every week) inside `outputs.contribution.<channel>`, at the default 90% credible level. A failed fit covers nothing. Spend is data, not a parameter, so each ROI draw is that channel's contribution draw over a fixed summed spend: the two intervals cover together or miss together, and the two columns below agree by construction.
- Bar: overall ROI coverage and overall contribution coverage each in [80%, 98%]. The binomial standard error at 90% nominal is 2.1 points overall (200 trials) and 4.2 points per channel (50 replicates).

## Result: PASS

| | ROI coverage | Contribution coverage |
|---|---|---|
| **overall** | **92.0% (184/200)** | **92.0% (184/200)** |
| tv | 86.0% (43/50) | 86.0% (43/50) |
| search | 92.0% (46/50) | 92.0% (46/50) |
| social | 100.0% (50/50) | 100.0% (50/50) |
| display | 90.0% (45/50) | 90.0% (45/50) |

| channel | mean median-ROI error | mean \|median-ROI error\| | mean 90% width / true ROI |
|---|---|---|---|
| tv | -0.05% | 0.63% | 2.3% |
| search | +0.04% | 0.73% | 3.0% |
| social | -0.49% | 2.47% | 13.6% |
| display | -0.19% | 1.13% | 4.3% |

## Runtime and sampler health

- Median fit 39.0 s (min 34.7 s, max 46.0 s); study wall time 16m29s with 2 concurrent fit(s) on darwin/arm64, GOMAXPROCS 10.
- Failed fits: 0. Fits with a warning: 0.
